body.message:
I’m currently on vacation in France, and I’ll be arriving in Dubai during the night from Thursday to Friday. I know the building and the apartments well because I lived at MAG 318 for six months in a studio.

If you can guarantee that the apartment is clean, with no cockroach problems and no water leaks, I’m happy to take it without viewing it first.

Regarding the check-in, I won’t be able to be there because, as I mentioned earlier, I’ll be arriving during the night. Is self-check-in available? If not, my best friend lives at MAG 318 and could do the check-in on my behalf, so that when I arrive, he can give me the access card and keys.
